name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
summary: Public research university in Urbana-Champaign, Illinois: 61,000+ students, 150+ programmes; you apply directly to a major, with a second choice.

ib.text: No IB points minimum: Illinois says it does not use the total diploma number. It reads your IB term grades for years 9 to 11 and in-progress year 12 courses, entered by hand in the Common App.

dates.label: Early Action (non-binding) closes; materials due 7 November

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: The BS in Computer Science from the Grainger College of Engineering, taught through the Siebel School of Computing and Data Science, with a rigorous computer science and technical core and 17+ blended CS degrees.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply directly to the major; engineering and CS are the most selective choices, so name a second-choice major.

flagshipSource.title: Illinois Grainger College of Engineering: facts and rankings

programmes.name: Accountancy
programmes.about: A Gies College of Business major on how money and other assets flow through businesses and economies; you can explore before you declare, and Gies also offers an Accountancy + Data Science option.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply directly to the Accountancy major in Gies and can name a second-choice major.

flagshipSource.title: Gies College of Business: BS in Accountancy

notes: International students must show English proficiency by TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, ACT or SAT unless they completed grades 10-12 in an approved English-speaking country; this cannot be waived.
2026-27 estimates for international students: tuition and fees $42,248 to $53,078 by major, food and housing $15,858, total $62,146 to $72,976.
Illinois guarantees the same tuition each year for students who qualify for its tuition guarantee program.
